layouts.title: Arrival Span
features: One continuous bridge through the astral void
Slender rails and a thin suspended deck
Broken arrival arches, not separate islands
The route continues toward the distant boss gate
layouts.description: The arrival section of one long floating bridge. Thin suspended stonework, ruined edge pillars and open space replace detached square platforms.

layouts.title: Ruined Crossing
features: The same bridge passing ruined gate pylons
Crumbling edge masonry and flying buttresses
No cathedral room or detached fighting platform
The far sanctuary stays connected by the bridge
layouts.description: The same uninterrupted bridge passing ruined gate pylons and crumbling edge masonry. This is a zone along the route, not a cathedral fighting room.

layouts.title: Celestial Approach
features: The final long span toward the sanctuary
A celestial armillary beside the route
Luminous edge inlay guides the approach
Continuous walkable paving into the boss terminus
layouts.description: A long celestial approach with luminous edge inlay, a nearby armillary and the sanctuary ahead. The paving remains connected from arrival to the boss.

layouts.title: Bridge-End Sanctuary
features: Widened sanctuary at the end of the bridge
The approach bridge remains visibly attached
Broken celestial gate beyond the boss position
Not an isolated circular arena or stone island
layouts.description: The bridge flares into a pointed end sanctuary with a flat ceremonial seal and broken celestial gate. The approach stays attached; this is not a separate round island.

layouts.title: Outer Fissure
features: Irregular cooled-lava shelf
One-sided molten fissure
Cooled spills & fractured basalt
Loose volcanic rubble
layouts.description: An exposed shelf beside an irregular molten fissure. Scattered short basalt outcrops and cooled spill tongues replace continuous walls and paired lava stripes.

layouts.title: Magma Gallery
features: Wide magma basin & twin cascades
Molten overflow around the side ledges
Crusted lava islands
Sheared cliff on the opposite bank
layouts.description: A large asymmetric magma basin with twin lava falls and crusted islands on one side, opposed by a sheared basalt cliff on the other.

layouts.title: Core Approach
features: Two active side calderas
Radial heat fractures & cooled spills
Obsidian ribs & glowing vents
Lava streams around the approach
layouts.description: An active caldera approach framed by two volcanic vents, molten spills, obsidian ribs and more severe floor damage. Not another waterfall-gallery layout.

layouts.title: Primal Core
features: 54-unit circular obsidian arena
Arena surrounded by a broad lava lake
Radial fractured basalt crown
Giant rear caldera & molten breach
layouts.description: A circular obsidian dais in a broad lava lake, encircled by a fractured basalt crown, with a giant volcanic caldera behind it. No rectangular causeway floor.
